services.name: Night Manta Ray Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: You will be snorkeling with one of the most graceful creatures in the ocean, manta rays. About After watching one of Kona’s sunsets on the boat ride to the site you’ll slip into the water after dark, with your guide, and snorkel above majestic manta rays as they somersault below you. This will be an awesome story you’ll tell forever! For safety, ALL guests MUST be able to swim 50 yards unassisted, have prior snorkeling experience, and be in good physical and mental health. Kids ages 5+ are welcome if they meet these requirements. Prices vary with demand. Plus tax and fees. Trip Details Destination: To see mantas! Duration: Early Evening Trip - 2 hours In-water snorkeling time: 30-40 minutes

services.name: Captain Cook Monument Kealakekua Bay Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: Duration 4.5 Hours Description Enjoy an exhilarating ride down the Kona coast to snorkel the beautiful calm waters of Kealakekua Bay, where the famous Captain Cook Monument is located. This pristine reef has an abundance of endemic fish (fish found only in Hawaii) and is the perfect place for beginner snorkelers to get hooked on viewing what's under the sea. This is the top-rated snorkel spot on Hawaii island! Inclusions Snacks & Drinks are provided during this trip Mask, snorkels, fins, and additional flotation Details Suitable for ages 3+ 17 & under must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times You should be in good physical and mental health to participate in this activity. services.name: Kona Snorkeling in Pawai Bay
services.desc: Description Skip the crowds at Kealakekua Bay and snorkel our stunning local sites instead - only accessible by boat. With just a 10 - 15 minute boat ride instead of a 45-minute ride, you'll spend more time in the water getting up close and personal with the gorgeous fish on one or two of our lovely local reefs. Less time on the water means more time in the water! Discover the volcanic formations and dramatic arches made by past lava flows. Duration: 2.5 hours Our afternoon snorkeling trip takes place in Pawai Bay - ocean permitting - only accessible to guests by boat - that area of coastline is set aside for the use of native Hawaiian children, inaccessible to non-natives.
